**Egg whites:** The scrambled egg whites cover about 12 × 10 cm and look about 2.5 cm high. That is roughly 120 cm² of footprint. With a loose, fluffy pile I estimate about 40% fill, which gives about 120 cm³ and so about 110 g. They look like plain egg whites at about 52 kcal per 100 g.

**Bacon:** I count about 3 strips of cooked bacon, each roughly 14 cm long. Cooked strips weigh about 6 g each, so the total is about 18 g. Cooked bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g.
